text:
incident-bot: Pager P1 — metering.delta-spike triggered for service=metering-emitter. token_delta_rate > 3x baseline in last 5m. link: https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/1820

alex_oncall: acked. oncall taking triage. starting quick surface-level checks.

maria_metering: do we know if this is customer-visible yet? any overage flags firing?

sam_billing: yes, billing pipeline reports ~120 customers with overage_flag=true in the last 8m. dashboard: https://billing.redwood/internal/overage?since=8m

priya_support: we already have two incoming tickets from customers saying they got overage emails ~5m ago. IDs: #2348, #2349.

alex_oncall: copying logs, running tail on emitter.

alex_oncall: ```
$ kubectl -n metering logs -l app=metering-emitter -f --tail=200 | grep -i retry
[emitter] WARN retrying request id=abc123 attempts=5 status=429
[emitter] WARN retrying request id=def456 attempts=4 status=429
[metering] EMIT delta_tokens=15432 account=ac_09
[metering] EMIT delta_tokens=16312 account=ac_42
```

maria_metering: running quick aggregate to confirm magnitude:
```sql
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) as window, sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM metering.emits
WHERE ts > now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY window
ORDER BY window DESC
LIMIT 6;
```

maria_metering: result: last three windows: 1.8M, 2.2M, 2.5M tokens — baseline is ~700k per minute for this fleet. so ~3x spike yes.

chen_platform: possible root cause: emitter ack path mis-acks causing duplicate retries + scheduler backlog. seeing spikes in emitter latency (~450ms -> 2.1s) and a backlog of 30k inflight.

alex_oncall: can we scope by region? looks noisy from eu-west-1 primarily.

maria_metering: filter by region: ```SELECT region, sum(tokens) FROM metering.emits WHERE ts > now()- interval '10 minutes' GROUP BY region;``` -> eu-west-1 ~5.4M, us-east-1 ~1.2M

sam_billing: billing service is ingesting these emits and triggering overage flags. recommendation: mute overage notifications for affected customers while we investigate to avoid charging noise.

priya_support: agree — mute is necessary. I can message customers in the affected cohort once we have a mitigation ETA.

alex_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) disable emitter automatic retries in eu-west-1 (hotfix) 2) deploy temporary rate cap on metering-emits ingestion for eu-west-1 3) mute overage notifications and create billing rollback ticket if charges applied. executing step 1 now.

alex_oncall: `/deploy metering-emitter --region=eu-west-1 --set retry.policy=disabled --reason="hotfix: retry storm"`

devops-bot: Deploy started: metering-emitter eu-west-1 (run id: dpl-4821). ETA ~45s.

(45s later)

devops-bot: Deploy succeeded: metering-emitter eu-west-1 (run id: dpl-4821).

alex_oncall: observing token emit rate dropping in eu-west-1 now. last windows: 2.5M -> 900k -> 720k. good sign.

maria_metering: starting reconciliation run: spin up read-only backfill to dedupe duplicates and compute delta. estimate 2-3 hours for full reconciliation for last 24h. running a quick sample to estimate false-positives.

sam_billing: muting overage emails and webhook notifications for affected customers. created billing ticket #B-908 with severity high for possible credit/rollback.

priya_support: updated customers in tickets #2348/#2349 with "we're investigating, notifications muted, will follow up with credits if needed".

chen_platform: root cause hypothesis: under high latency, emitter client retries without idempotency key leading to duplicate emits; second-order effect: metering ingest windowing treats duplicates as new tokens. short-term: disable retries + add dedupe window on ingest side. long-term: require idempotency headers from emitter clients.

alex_oncall: can we add ingest-side dedupe quickly as a safety net? even a short 1-minute dedupe TTL would cut duplicates.

maria_metering: yes, I can roll a dedupe filter in front of the ingestion stream (scoping to eu-west-1 only) — patching now. Expected <15m to rollout.

(10m later)

maria_metering: dedupe filter deployed in eu-west-1. visible duplicate reduction ~88% in sample. token rate stabilized.

sam_billing: monitoring billing downstream — overage flags stopped rising for new customers. existing flagged customers still marked until reconciliation.

priya_support: no new customer complaints in last 12m. I set a support priority to low for outreach after reconciliation.

alex_oncall: handoff: I have to step away for 2h. leaving incident to chen_platform for follow-up and full reconciliation. summary: mitigation applied (retries disabled, dedupe applied), mute in place, billing ticket created. please call me if rollback required. :thumbsup:

chen_platform: taking it. I'll own the postmortem and verify reconciliation. ping me for anything urgent.

incident-bot: incident updated — status=mitigating, severity=P1 -> P2 (customer-impact: overage_flags triggered; confirmed no automated billing charges post-mitigation; action=mute_notifications + backfill/reconcile). link: https://ops.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-1820

sam_billing: leaving notes for finance: possible credits needed, await reconciliation results. created finance ticket FIN-451.

maria_metering: scheduled reconciliation job started (run id: recon-771). will post ETA updates in this thread.

chen_platform: thanks all. I'll do a handoff summary for the on-call rotation and post a short timeline + recommended follow-ups (dedupe TTL increase, emitter idempotency, ingestion schema change).

priya_support: noted. I'll queue customer communications post-reconcile.

incident-bot: Incident timeline event: mitigation applied at 181999 + 900s; mitigation stable.

alex_oncall: back in 2h — good job everyone.

(End of thread)
